en: Illustrated Easter postcard. Front shows a Swedish Easter witch riding a broom with a coffee pot, flying up from a cracked egg cup that emits smoke; a laughing child in a red cap looks up. Large Swedish greeting reads "ROLIG PÅSK!" and a short verse is printed on the egg cup; artist's signature and number 228 at bottom. Reverse is a classic multi‑language 'CARTE POSTALE/POST CARD' back with handwritten address to Malmö and a faint circular postmark.
